deficiencies.description: The rewrite turns the lecturer's pointing words into a description that the tumour lies next to the outer surface, which the lecturer did not explicitly state.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus,

deficiencies.description: The rewrite changes a statement pointing to a specific structure ('This') that is a thin muscle wall into a general claim that the uterus normally has a very thin muscle wall.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: This is normally a very thin muscle wall that is present in the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: the uterus, which normally has a very thin muscle wall.

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The rewrite changes 'circumspect' to 'circumscribed'. This is a valid correction of a transcriber error to a scientifically correct medical term, which is an allowed change.
